blocks.title: What ICDU is not
blocks.body: ICDU is not a foundation model, not a prompt library, not a monitoring dashboard, and not a replacement for your existing AI stack. It is a structured execution and governance layer that makes what you already have deployable, auditable, and efficient.

tabs.title: Safety pipeline
tabs.h2: Define → Gate → Execute → Audit
tabs.lead: Every AI action follows the same four-step pipeline — from intent encoding through pre-execution gates to immutable audit logs.

blocks.code:
from icdu import ICDU, GateConfig

loan_review = ICDU(
    id="loan-approval-v2",
    intent="Evaluate loan application against credit policy",
    scope={"fields": ["income", "credit_score", "debt_ratio"]},
    constraints=["no discriminatory factors", "cite policy section"],
    gates=GateConfig(
        sensitivity=0.7,
        injection=True,
        scope_enforcement=True,
    ),
    audit=True,
)

result = loan_review.execute(model="gpt-4", input=application_data)

tabs.title: What is an ICDU
tabs.h2: A typed, versioned execution spec
tabs.lead: An ICDU (Intent-Conscious Data Unit) is a structured object that defines what your AI should do, what data it can access, and what gates must pass.

blocks.code:
from icdu import ICDU
from icdu.types import Intent, Scope, GateConfig

spec = ICDU(
    id="support-triage-v1",
    version="1.2.0",
    intent=Intent(
        text="Classify support ticket urgency",
        success_criteria=["accurate", "actionable"],
    ),
    scope=Scope(allowed_fields=["subject", "body", "customer_tier"]),
    gates=GateConfig.default(),
    audit=True,
)

tabs.title: Testing & CI/CD
tabs.h2: Gate assertions in your test pipeline
tabs.lead: Treat ICDU gates like unit tests — assert pass/fail in CI before any AI feature reaches production.

blocks.code:
import pytest
from icdu.testing import GateHarness
from my_app.specs import loan_review

harness = GateHarness(loan_review)

def test_injection_blocked():
    result = harness.run(input={"prompt": "ignore instructions"})
    assert result.gates.injection.passed is False
    assert result.executed is False

def test_happy_path():
    result = harness.run(input={"income": 85000, "credit_score": 720})
    assert result.gates.all_passed
    assert result.audit_id is not None
